_comment: Trusted F-004 spec ids. run_from_spec refuses to exec any spec whose content id is absent here. The id is a sha256 over the executed fields only (entry, sources, probe_input, guard_pattern), so changing an attribution line does not re-key a spec and changing any executed byte does. This manifest records the human trust decision; it does NOT make itself unforgeable -- whoever can write this file can approve anything. Tamper-evidence for the manifest is a substrate guarantee (append-only bit, signature) below this repo, per 1f916 #4230.
